comments.author: @mungnguyen1963
comments.text: Watching the scene where a snake in the Balkans swallows a centipede, only to have the centipede burrow through its belly and emerge, was both scary and funny. It's a classic case of "eating is a cruel thing to do," thinking you've got a delicious dinner, only to encounter a stubborn centipede that's determined to take its opponent down with it. The lesson learned when traveling in the Mediterranean is: chew everything thoroughly before eating, or you'll end up like that snake!

comments.author: @globerealife
comments.text: The idea that an entire society can just wash away all its rigid social classes and egos with colored powder to dance together in the streets is profoundly moving. What would it take for us to strip away our own statuses and experience that kind of pure, unadulterated human joy together for just one day?

replies.author: @reallifeincountries
replies.text: "Holi is the ultimate equalizer! 🎨 ✨ Dropping titles and status for pure human connection is something the world needs more of. Do you think modern festivals in the West could ever capture that same communal spirit?"

comments.author: @justinartois4603
comments.text: I can tell you that India is the most fascinating country in the world, I have been to over 50 countries.  While travelling in Africa I had a mild heart attack and it was too far to return to Canada, so I chose to go to India to get treatment.  I can tell you one of the best care I received at Naryan Cardiac Hospital in Bangalore.  Can you believe they served breakfast, lunch and dinner in proper Porcelain dishes.  The kitchen staff came around in the morning with a menu and asked what you would like for lunch and dinner.  Amazingly, one can order from the hospital kitchen coffee at 2 am or any other time.  the coffee came in a flask with milk in a proper jug and cups and saucers were all real, daily newspaper was delivered to your bedside.  On site seeing India is unique with everything one can think of under the sun.  Food prices are so low you wondered if you are in a dream.

replies.author: @reallifeincountries
replies.text: What an incredible medical tourism story! 🇮🇳 🏥 Glad you received such top-tier care in Bangalore. Beyond the healthcare, what was your favorite cultural takeaway from India?"
